nodes.title: The voice runtime is the one caller of Plivo's Call API for every agent call (test ring, single, API, campaign, retry, callback); the control plane's PlivoTelephony never places an agent call and calls Plivo only for account work (numbers, the inbound application, CDRs) and the fixed verification announcement (systemCall)
nodes.rationale: The runtime owns the answer, hang-up, stream, transfer and machine endpoints and already needs the credentials for transfer, keys and hang-up; the lab rang real phones exactly this way (voicelab/server/phone.py). Moving the dial to the control plane would split the call's carrier state across two processes. Shapes checked 2026-10-24 against plivo.com/docs/voice/api/call/make-a-call and docs.plivo.com/docs/account/api/application.
nodes.reverse_if: a second runtime trunk (Exotel outbound) or a carrier needs a dial the runtime cannot make, or the control plane must place calls while no runtime is up (then one CarrierDialer used by both, still behind the allowlist)

nodes.title: VP_TELEPHONY_ALLOWED_TO is checked on every number that can reach the carrier: the dial gate's G2 (person dialled on every attempt kind, and the agent's hand-off number), inbound answering (hand-off number), phone verification, and PlivoTelephony.systemCall as the last wall. A server that can reach a carrier (VP_TELEPHONY_LIVE=1 or VP_RUNTIME_URL set) with no list refuses every number; VP_TELEPHONY_ALLOWLIST=off is the only open switch, never on staging
nodes.rationale: Owner directive 2026-10-24: live calls on private staging to the owner's own phone. A wrong number rung by a test build is the worst first-call failure; failing closed costs nothing.
nodes.reverse_if: production launch with the owner's go: set VP_TELEPHONY_ALLOWLIST=off on production only

nodes.title: tests/telephony-allowlist.test.ts 6/6 on a fresh Postgres 16: 6 attempt kinds x (unlisted refused, never handed to the runtime, no hold; listed dialled with exactly that number), closed-without-list and 'off', 6 kinds x unlisted hand-off number refused, verification refused before counting, the Plivo adapter refuses with zero requests at a fake Plivo
nodes.method: node:test against a throwaway Postgres 16 and a local fake Plivo HTTP server; FakeRuntime records tickets

nodes.title: Runtime half of the live phone path, asked of the voice builder: VP_PLIVO_API_BASE (loopback only) for a cross-process fake-Plivo test; the same allowlist in plivo_dial and transfer; X-Plivo-Signature-V3 with nonce on answer/hangup/transfer/machine/inbound; a short-lived stream token; call.ended.carrier (CallUUID, Duration, BillDuration, HangupCause*, answeredBy, dial error); recording both legs on s2s phone calls
nodes.closes_when: the voice builder lands each ask with tests, or says why not
